data.heading: Answers before you ask
data.subheading: Everything teams want to know before moving their reporting into Lumen.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most teams are live in under an hour. Connect your data sources, pick a template and invite your colleagues.

items.question: Which data sources can I connect?
items.answer: Over 80 connectors including Postgres, BigQuery, Stripe, HubSpot and Google Analytics, plus a REST API for anything else.

items.question: Can I white-label dashboards for clients?
items.answer: Yes. On the Agency plan you can use your own logo, colours and domain on every shared dashboard.

items.question: Is there a limit on viewers?
items.answer: No. Viewers are always free; you only pay for the people who build and edit reports.

items.question: Do you offer SSO?
items.answer: SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning are included on the Business plan and above.
